meta.title: AssetFlow: bond servicing, enforced on Solana
meta.description: Open-source servicing for tokenized bonds and funds: who may hold them, coupons counted on-chain on every record date and paid in USDC, redemptions and maturity, private holdings on MagicBlock, and a circuit breaker for trading pools.

nav.clusterHint: The Solana cluster this app reads and writes

footer.line: Open source under MIT. Built natively on Solana with Token-2022, Token ACL (sRFC-37), the Solana Attestation Service and MagicBlock; also on Base, Arbitrum and Robinhood Chain with the Ethereum Attestation Service.
footer.legal: Devnet software, not audited. Nothing on this site is an offer to sell or a solicitation to buy any security.
footer.tagline: Servicing for tokenized bonds and funds: who may hold them, what each holder is owed, and how they redeem.

home.title: Bond servicing, enforced on Solana.
home.lede: AssetFlow decides who may hold a tokenized bond, counts its holders on-chain on every record date, and pays coupons and redemptions in USDC.

register.title: Coupon 1, counted on-chain
register.note: Anyone counts the register on the record date, one account at a time, until it equals the supply. No Merkle root, no list to trust. Devnet, October 4, 2026.

product.title: Issuance is day one. AssetFlow runs every day after.
product.lede: Tokenizing a bond takes one transaction. Running it takes years, and today that work lives in spreadsheets and email next to a token that knows nothing about it.

admit.label: Admit
admit.title: Only eligible wallets can hold it.
admit.body: Every holder account starts frozen. A wallet is let in only while its investor profile passes the registry, checked by the token itself.

checks.c1: Accounts thaw through Token ACL, never by hand
checks.c2: KYC once, from a Solana Attestation Service credential
checks.c3: A lapsed approval can be frozen by anyone

rows.r5: Investor tier 1 meets the minimum of 1
rows.r6: Hong Kong is an allowed jurisdiction

pay.label: Pay
pay.title: Every coupon, counted on-chain.
pay.body: On the record date anyone counts the register, account by account, until it equals the supply. Then every eligible holder is paid in USDC.

checks.c1: A funded vault per payment, capped so none overdraws another
checks.c2: Ineligible holders are held back, not paid

redeem.label: Redeem
redeem.title: Redemptions priced by the program.
redeem.body: Early redemptions settle at face plus accrued interest. At maturity the mint authority is dropped and every eligible holding is paid at face.

private.label: Private
private.title: Private holdings, the same rules.
private.body: Holders can move units into MagicBlock's Private Ephemeral Rollup. Balances leave public view; both sides must still be eligible.

protect.label: Protect
protect.title: A dump freezes the pool.
protect.body: A trading pool trades only while a fresh risk decision allows it. Past its band from the bond's value, anyone can freeze it. No oracle.

why.title: Why Solana.
why.lede: AssetFlow is built on Solana's own standards rather than around them: compliance at the account level, reusable KYC, payouts cheap enough to make one by one, and private balances that auditors can still read.

r3.v: Asks AssetFlow before any thaw or freeze

r4.v: KYC once, reused by every registry

tokenAcl.title: Compliance without a transfer hook
tokenAcl.body: Token ACL, the Solana Foundation's sRFC-37 standard, lets AssetFlow's program decide which accounts may thaw. A plain Token-2022 transfer runs none of our code, so any program that handles Token-2022 can move the asset.

sas.title: KYC once, reusable
sas.body: The Solana Attestation Service holds credentials an investor can reuse. A registry that trusts the provider writes the profile from the attestation: verified once, admitted everywhere that provider is trusted.

fees.title: Pay every holder on-chain
fees.body: The base fee is 5,000 lamports per signature, so each holder's coupon can be its own on-chain payment instead of a line in a batch file.

privacy.title: Private balances, the same rules
privacy.body: MagicBlock's Private Ephemeral Rollup runs holdings on a validator in a trusted execution environment. Only the holder, the issuer, compliance and a named auditor can read a balance.

institutions.title: Where tokenized funds are launching
institutions.body: The Solana Foundation reports bond and fund launches on Solana including Baillie Gifford's BAGEY bond fund (June 2026) and commercial paper for Galaxy arranged by J.P. Morgan (December 2025).

programCard.title: One program, open to read
programCard.body: Every guarantee on the proof page is enforced by one Anchor program on devnet. Read it in the explorer, or in the repository with its 91 tests.

life.title: One bond, start to maturity.

issue.title: Issue
issue.body: A Token-2022 mint whose accounts start frozen. Every authority sits on a program account, not a person.

admit.title: Admit
admit.body: KYC once: the investor presents an attestation, and the gate lets their account thaw.

record.title: Record date
record.body: The mint pauses and anyone counts the register on-chain until it equals the supply.

pay.title: Pay
pay.body: Each holder's coupon is computed from the terms and paid in USDC. Ineligible holders are held back.

redeem.title: Redeem
redeem.body: Early redemptions settle at face plus accrued interest. The units burn as the cash moves.

mature.title: Mature
mature.body: The mint authority is dropped for good, and every eligible holding redeems at face.

life.note: One devnet bond has run this whole life: four coupons, an early redemption and maturity.
life.noteLink: Check it on the proof page

buyers.title: Built for the people who run bonds.

issuers.title: Issuers
issuers.body: Of tokenized bonds, notes and funds who want eligibility, coupons and redemptions enforced by the token itself.

admins.title: Fund administrators and transfer agents
admins.body: Who keep registers by hand today and want a record-date count that anyone can check.

platforms.title: Tokenization platforms
platforms.body: That issue on Solana for their clients and would rather not build servicing themselves.

custody.a: No. Units sit in holders' own token accounts, and the escrows for redemptions and private holdings belong to program accounts, not to a person. AssetFlow is servicing software; it does not take custody of investor assets.

audit.a: Not yet. It runs on Solana devnet only, with 91 program tests passing. An independent audit comes before any real money.

wallets.q: Which wallets can hold the token?
wallets.a: Any wallet that supports Token-2022. Accounts start frozen; the holder portal thaws an eligible holder's account through Token ACL, and after that a plain transfer runs none of our code.

pilot.a: Nothing. A pilot shadows one coupon cycle on devnet beside your current process: no custody, no real money, nothing to change in how you issue. Proposed production pricing is on the pricing page.

chains.a: Yes. The same servicing runs as Solidity on Base, Arbitrum and Robinhood Chain with the Ethereum Attestation Service, with pilot notes on Base and Arbitrum One mainnet. Its first version runs on HashKey Chain mainnet.

open.a: Yes, under MIT: the Anchor program, the console and the tests. ARCHITECTURE.md maps every account and flow in 22 diagrams.

closing.title: Run one coupon cycle with us.
closing.body: We are looking for our first design partners, starting in Hong Kong and Singapore. Bring one bond, and we will run its next coupon on devnet beside your current process.

tx.onChainRefusal: The refusal is recorded on-chain. Open the transaction to see the program's own log.

refusal.Unauthorized: The connected wallet does not hold the role this needs.
refusal.NotEligible: Refused by the AssetFlow gate: this wallet is not eligible to hold the asset.
refusal.StillEligible: Refused: this holder is still eligible, so nobody can freeze them without compliance.
refusal.TooManyJurisdictions: The registry already allows the maximum number of jurisdictions.
refusal.InvalidAmount: The amount must be greater than zero.
refusal.MintAuthorityNotAsset: The mint's authority must be the asset account.
refusal.FreezeAuthorityNotAsset: The mint's freeze authority must be the asset account.
refusal.MintNotFresh: Only a mint with nothing issued yet can be registered.
refusal.MintNotToken2022: The asset must be a Token-2022 mint.
refusal.ForbiddenExtension: The mint carries an extension a serviced asset may not have.
refusal.DefaultStateNotFrozen: Holder accounts of a serviced asset must start frozen.
refusal.DelegateNotAsset: The permanent delegate must be the asset account.
refusal.PauseAuthorityNotAsset: The pause authority must be the asset account.
refusal.OwnerNotImmutable: Refused: this holder account's owner could be changed later, so the gate will not open it.
refusal.WrongMint: That token account belongs to a different asset.
refusal.AccountFrozen: Refused by Token-2022: the account is frozen.
refusal.Rejected: You declined the request in your wallet.
refusal.Unknown: The transaction failed. The program log below has the details.
refusal.InvalidTerms: The instrument terms are not valid.
refusal.InvalidPeriod: There is no such coupon period.
refusal.RecordDateNotReached: The record date has not been reached yet.
refusal.RegisterWindowOpen: Another register is being fixed; the asset is paused until it is committed.
refusal.WrongPayoutStatus: The payment is not at the right step for this.
refusal.TotalMismatch: The register does not add up to the units outstanding at the record date.
refusal.Underfunded: Not fully funded yet: nothing is paid until all of it is.
refusal.InvalidProof: The proof does not match the committed register.
refusal.Overdrawn: Paying this would exceed what was funded.
refusal.MathOverflow: The amount is too large to compute.
refusal.WrongDestination: The payment must go to an account the holder owns.
refusal.AssetMatured: The asset has matured: no unit can be issued or redeemed early again.
refusal.MaturityNotReached: The asset has not reached its maturity date.
refusal.CouponsOutstanding: Every coupon's register must be committed before maturity.
refusal.RequestClosed: That redemption request has already been answered.
refusal.HoldingFrozen: The holding account is frozen; it must be activated first.
refusal.NotAHolding: The asset's own escrow is not a holding.
refusal.KycSourceNotSet: This registry trusts no KYC provider.
refusal.NotAnAttestation: That is not an attestation from the Solana Attestation Service.
refusal.AttestationMismatch: The attestation is not from the provider this registry trusts, or not about this wallet.
refusal.WrongSchemaLayout: That schema does not carry AssetFlow's investor fields (jurisdiction, tier, accredited).
refusal.StillAttested: The attestation still vouches for this investor.
refusal.AlreadyPaid: This holder has already been paid for this coupon.
refusal.NothingHeld: This wallet held no units then.
refusal.OpenRequest: This holder has a redemption request open; it must be withdrawn first.
refusal.UnitsLocked: Those units are waiting on a redemption request and cannot move.
refusal.InsufficientBalance: This wallet does not hold enough of the payment currency for this.
refusal.CountIncomplete: The register has not counted every unit yet: count the remaining accounts first.
refusal.CountOverflow: Counting this would take the register past the supply.
refusal.PreviousPeriodOpen: The previous coupon's register is not counted yet.
refusal.PrivatePoolMismatch: The private escrow does not hold what was deposited less what was released.
refusal.PrivateLedgerMismatch: This holder's private ledger and holding disagree.
refusal.CheckpointRequired: A coupon register was fixed: record it on the private ledger first.
refusal.ValidatorNotAllowed: Private holdings go only to MagicBlock's private rollup validator.
refusal.PrivateNotDelegated: The private account is not in the private rollup.
refusal.PrivateAlreadyDelegated: The private account is already in the private rollup.
refusal.NotProtected: The private holding has no read permission yet: make it private first.
refusal.HoldingOnHold: The private holding is on a compliance hold.
refusal.InvalidVenue: The trading pool's terms are not valid.
refusal.VenueClosed: The trading pool is closed: there is no fresh allow decision since it last tripped.
refusal.VenueOpen: The trading pool is open, so its account cannot be frozen.
refusal.NotTheVenueAccount: Only the pool's approved account can be reopened.

holder.noAssetHint: Open this page from a link your issuer shares, or pick an asset in the issuer console.

holder.loading: Reading your standing from the chain…

account.title: Holding account
account.noneBody: You have no account for this asset yet. Opening one and asking the gate to activate it is a single transaction.
account.frozenBody: Accounts for this asset start frozen, or were frozen when an approval lapsed. The gate activates it once you are eligible.
account.activeBody: Your account can receive and send this asset to other eligible holders.
account.tryAnywayHint: The request goes on-chain and the gate refuses it; the refusal gets its own transaction you can open.

holder.onboardBody: Send this address to the issuer. Once they add your profile, come back and activate your account.

coupons.title: Coupons
coupons.none: This asset has no coupon schedule.
coupons.lede: {rate}% a year, paid to the wallet that holds the units on each record date.

redeem.title: Redemptions
redeem.none: Redemptions are priced from the instrument terms, and this asset has none yet.
redeem.lede: Ask the issuer to redeem units before maturity. They wait in escrow until the issuer settles or declines, and you can withdraw the request until then.
redeem.quoteNote: Priced by the program on the day the issuer settles: face plus the interest accrued to that day.
redeem.nothingHeld: You hold no units of this asset.
redeem.notEligible: Only an eligible holder can ask to redeem.
redeem.matured: Matured on {date}: each unit redeems at its face, {face}.
redeem.awaitingFunds: Waiting for the issuer to fund the principal: {funded} of {required}.
redeem.heldAtMaturity: You are not eligible right now. Your units stay yours, and the principal waits in the vault until you are.
redeem.escrowNote: {units} units wait in escrow. They are still yours on a record date, so their coupon comes to you.

kyc.title: KYC once
kyc.none: This issuer accepts investors verified by {provider}. Get verified there once, and every registry that trusts {provider} admits you without paperwork.
kyc.revoked: Your attestation from {provider} is gone or no longer valid, so this profile can be withdrawn by anyone. Get verified again to keep it.
kyc.ready: {provider} attests you: {jurisdiction}, tier {tier}. Onboard with it: your profile is written from the attestation and your account activated, in one transaction.
kyc.policyWarning: This registry's policy does not admit what the attestation says, so you can onboard but the gate will not let you in.

private.title: Private holding
private.lede: Units you park here are held in MagicBlock's private rollup: only you, the issuer and compliance can see your balance, your private transfers and your coupons. Every deposit and every release is a public token movement on Solana.
private.ledeAuditor: Units you park here are held in MagicBlock's private rollup: only you, the issuer, compliance and the auditor {auditor} can see your balance, your private transfers and your coupons. Every deposit and every release is a public token movement on Solana.
private.openNote: One transaction on Solana opens your account and puts it in the private rollup. It holds a small amount of SOL as rent and pays MagicBlock's session fee.
private.openIneligible: Only a wallet eligible to hold the asset can open a private account.
private.onSolana: Your holding is back on Solana: take everything out to your own accounts, or return it to the private rollup.
private.returnToRollup: Return it to the private rollup
private.signIn: Sign in to see your private holding
private.signInNote: Your wallet signs a message, not a transaction.
private.cannotSign: This wallet cannot sign messages, which the private rollup needs.
private.signInFailed: The private rollup did not accept the sign-in.
private.unreadable: The private rollup does not show this holding to this wallet.
private.publicLine: Public on Solana: {deposited} deposited and {released} released in all.
private.protectNote: Until its read permission exists, a holding is not private, so nothing is credited to it before.
private.recordNote: A coupon register was fixed: your ledger records what you had deposited and released by then before anything moves again. Anyone can send this.
private.claim: Credit {n, plural, one {# coupon} other {# coupons}}
private.depositLabel: Move units in (you hold {units} on Solana)
private.sendLabel: Send privately to another private holder
private.sendNote: Both of you must be eligible today. A transfer never takes more than you hold: check your balance afterwards.
private.takeOutLabel: Take units or coupon cash out
private.takeOutNote: The amounts become public when they land in your accounts on Solana. Coupon cash goes only to a wallet eligible at that time.
private.escapeTitle: Leave the private rollup without it running AssetFlow
private.escapeBody: Asks MagicBlock's delegation program on Solana to bring your holding back. Your balance becomes public when it does. If the rollup's validator is gone for good, holdings it never settled cannot be recovered.
private.escape: Bring my holding back to Solana

issuer.title: Issuer console
issuer.connectBody: The console reads your registry and assets from the chain. Every change is a transaction you sign.

onboarding.registryBody: The registry holds your compliance policy and one profile per approved wallet. Every asset you issue can be gated by it.
onboarding.chinaNote: Mainland China is off by default: its 2026 rules bar offshore tokenization of mainland assets without regulator approval.
onboarding.assetBody: One transaction creates the Token-2022 mint and puts it under AssetFlow. The program refuses any mint not built this way.

assetPoints.frozen: Every holder account starts frozen until the gate lets its owner in.
assetPoints.gate: Token ACL holds the freeze authority and asks AssetFlow before any thaw or freeze.
assetPoints.authorities: Mint, pause and permanent-delegate authority belong to the asset account, not to anyone's key.
assetPoints.extensions: No transfer hook, close authority or confidential transfers: nothing that opens a path around the gate.

overview.attentionNone: Every active holder is eligible today.
overview.attentionHint: Freeze them from the Investors tab. Anyone may; the gate agrees only for holders who no longer pass.

investors.lede: Every profile in the registry, with the holder accounts the chain has for this asset.
investors.empty: No investors yet. Add the first one.

editor.walletInvalid: That is not a Solana address.
editor.note: Saving changes the profile only. An account already active stays active until someone freezes it; the gate applies the new profile to every thaw and freeze from now on.

issuance.title: Issue units
issuance.lede: Only to an eligible holder. If their account is not open or active yet, it is opened and let through the gate in the same transaction.

rules.eligible: The holder passes the registry today, not only when their account was opened.
rules.recheck: The holder account's owner can never be reassigned.
rules.authority: Units are minted by the asset account, which only this program can sign for.

policy.title: Compliance policy
policy.lede: The rules the gate applies to every thaw and freeze for assets gated by this registry.
policy.notCompliance: The connected wallet is not this registry's compliance officer, so it cannot change the policy.
policy.effect: A tighter policy does not freeze anyone by itself. Holders who no longer pass show up under Needs attention, and anyone can freeze them.

kyc.title: KYC provider
kyc.lede: Trust a provider on the Solana Attestation Service, and investors it has verified onboard themselves: the program writes their profile from the attestation. Your policy still applies, and a compliance hold is never lifted by an attestation.
kyc.none: No provider trusted: every investor is onboarded by hand.
kyc.demoNote: Prefilled with AssetFlow's demo provider, which attests whatever a visitor picks.
kyc.trustsNote: If you stop trusting it, or switch providers, anyone can withdraw the approval of profiles that came from its attestations.

coupons.termsLede: Every coupon is computed by the program from these terms. They are set once and cannot be changed afterwards.
coupons.testUsdc: Test USDC on devnet: get 1,000 from the wallet menu.
coupons.demo: Demo schedule: record dates a few minutes apart, so a whole payment can be shown live
coupons.termsNote: Coupons are rounded down to the cent on each holder's whole holding. Accrual uses the dates above; the record and payment times say when the register is fixed and the coupon is due.
coupons.termsLine: {face} face per unit · {rate}% a year · 30/360 · paid in

steps.fix: Fix the register (pauses transfers, prices the payment)

coupons.fixedAt: Register fixed at slot {slot}: {units} units outstanding. The payment is priced from them.
coupons.waiting: Waiting for the record date. Anyone can fix the register once it passes.
coupons.lowBalance: Your wallet holds {balance} of the payment currency.
coupons.registerNote: Every line was counted on-chain from the holders' own accounts while transfers were paused. Each private holder's share of the pool is settled inside the private rollup.
coupons.countNote: Anyone can count the register: each holder account, each open redemption request and the private pool, once each. Once the count reaches the supply, anyone closes it and transfers resume. No key of yours is needed to end the pause.
coupons.countBatch: {n, plural, one {# account} other {# accounts}} counted
coupons.recordLedgers: The register recorded on {n, plural, one {# private ledger} other {# private ledgers}}
coupons.reclaim: Get back the rent of {n, plural, one {# counted marker} other {# counted markers}}
coupons.reclaimBatch: Rent of {n, plural, one {# marker} other {# markers}} returned

redemptions.noTerms: Redemptions are priced from the instrument terms. Set them on the Coupons tab first.
redemptions.requestsLede: Units wait in escrow until you answer. Settling pays face plus accrued interest, priced by the program, and burns the units in the same transaction. Rejecting returns them.
redemptions.noOpen: No requests waiting. Holders ask from their portal.
redemptions.balance: Your wallet holds {balance} of the payment currency.
redemptions.priceNote: The price is face plus 30/360 interest from the start of the current period, rounded down to the cent; none once that period's record date has passed, since the holder on the register takes the whole coupon.
redemptions.maturityLede: The asset matures after its last payment date, {date}. Every unit outstanding is then redeemed at face: {amount} in all.
redemptions.openAtMaturity: {n, plural, one {# request is} other {# requests are}} still in escrow. Reject them, or let the holders withdraw; the units are then redeemed with the rest.
redemptions.startedAt: Matured on {date}. No unit can be issued again, and each redeems at face once the principal is funded.
redemptions.lowBalance: Your wallet holds {balance} of the payment currency.
redemptions.heldNote: {units} units belong to holders who are not eligible. They keep them, and their principal waits in the vault until compliance clears them; redeem them then.

private.unreadable: Private holdings could not be read.
private.enableLede: Holders can then park units in an escrow on Solana and hold their share in MagicBlock's private rollup, where only they, you, compliance and an auditor you name can see balances and private transfers. The same eligibility rules bind every private move.
private.validatorTee: MagicBlock's Private Ephemeral Rollup, running in an Intel TDX trusted execution environment. The program accepts no other.
private.validatorLocal: MagicBlock's local development validator (solana/tests/rollup.sh). Not a TEE.
private.needsTerms: Set the coupon terms first: private coupons are paid in their currency.
private.enableNote: What stays public: who has a private account, every deposit into and release out of private holdings, and the escrow's total. What does not: balances, private transfers and each holder's coupon.
private.poolLede: The units in private holdings sit in an escrow the asset account owns. On a record date the register counts them as one line; each holder's share is settled in the rollup.
private.registerLede: Read through the private rollup: as the issuer you can see every private holding. Rebuild the read permissions after you change the auditor or the compliance key.
private.signIn: Sign in to the private rollup
private.signInNote: Your wallet signs a message, not a transaction: the rollup then shows you what you may read.
private.cannotSign: This wallet cannot sign messages, which the private rollup needs.
private.signInFailed: The private rollup did not accept the sign-in.
private.publicNote: A hold stops a holding from sending units or taking them out; it can still receive. Only compliance can set or lift one.

pools.title: Trading pools
pools.lede: A circuit breaker for the pools this asset trades in. A pool's account of the asset trades only while a fresh risk decision allows it. The moment that lapses, or the pool's price strays past its band from the bond's own value, anyone can freeze it, and every swap against the pool fails before it trades. Wallet-to-wallet transfers are never touched.
pools.how1: Compliance approves one pool account of the asset. It starts closed.
pools.how2: The pool's risk authority, or compliance, allows trading for up to seven days, or blocks it at once.
pools.how3: Anyone can check the pool's price against the bond's value (face plus accrued interest, no oracle) and trip it. A tripped pool reopens only on a decision made after the trip.
pools.loading: Reading the pools from the chain…
pools.none: No pool is approved for this asset yet.
pools.termsFirst: Set the bond's terms first: the price check prices the pool against them.
pools.trippedAt: Tripped by a price check on {time}. It reopens only on a decision made after that.
pools.noDecision: No risk decision yet: the pool cannot trade.
pools.anyoneNote: Anyone can check the price, freeze a pool that is not trading, and reopen one that is. The gate decides.
pools.approveLede: Paste the pool's two token accounts: its account of this asset, and its account of the bond's payment currency. The pool's authority must not be an investor.
pools.quoteVault: Pool's account of the payment currency
pools.startsClosed: The pool starts closed. Allow trading when you are ready.
pools.notCompliance: Only this registry's compliance officer can approve or withdraw a pool.
pools.badBase: That is not an account of this asset.
pools.badQuote: The currency account must belong to the same pool and hold the bond's payment currency.

proof.title: On-chain proof
proof.noAsset: No asset selected. Open this page with ?asset=<mint> or from the issuer console.
proof.lede: Every guarantee AssetFlow makes, read back from the chain for asset
proof.loading: Reading the mint and its configuration…

token2022.title: A Token-2022 mint
token2022.why: The extensions below exist only in Token-2022.

frozenDefault.title: Holder accounts start frozen
frozenDefault.why: Default Account State is Frozen, so no account can hold or move units until the gate lets it in.

mintAuthority.title: Only the asset account can mint
mintAuthority.why: New units exist only through AssetFlow's issue instruction, which re-checks eligibility.

freezeAuthority.title: Token ACL holds the freeze authority
freezeAuthority.why: No person can freeze or thaw a holder directly.

gate.title: AssetFlow is the gate
gate.why: Token ACL asks this program before every permissionless thaw or freeze.

configAuthority.title: Token ACL's config answers to the asset account
configAuthority.why: No personal key can swap the gate, delete the config or thaw past it.

permissionless.title: Holders let themselves in; anyone can enforce
permissionless.why: Permissionless thaw and freeze are both on, and the gate decides each one.

delegate.title: The permanent delegate is the asset account
delegate.why: Maturity burns and court-ordered transfers go through the program's role checks.

pause.title: Only the asset account can pause
pause.why: Pausing fixes the register on the record date, and only while it is counted; no one else can stop transfers.

mintAuthorityMatured.title: Matured: nobody can mint
mintAuthorityMatured.why: Maturity removed the mint authority, so no unit can ever be issued again, by AssetFlow or anyone.

privateValidator.title: Private holdings live only in MagicBlock's private rollup
privateValidator.why: Every private account is delegated to the TEE validator the program pins; no other rollup can read them or settle their exits.

privateEscrow.title: The private escrow holds exactly what went in less what came out
privateEscrow.why: It belongs to the asset account, the gate never opens it, and its balance always equals deposits less releases.

proof.extensionsHint: Anything outside this set is refused at registration.
proof.hashkeyHint: AssetFlow's EVM contracts, deployed on HashKey Chain mainnet (chain 177) on {date}.
proof.poolsHint: A pool's account trades only while a fresh risk decision allows it and its price stays within the band of the bond's own value. Otherwise anyone can freeze it, and no swap against it can settle. Wallet-to-wallet transfers are never touched.

kyc.title: Demo KYC provider
kyc.subtitle: Get verified once, on the Solana Attestation Service
kyc.demoOnly: For testing only. This provider verifies nobody: it attests whatever you pick, so you can see how an investor verified once is admitted by every registry that trusts the provider.
kyc.unavailable: The demo KYC provider is not set up on this deployment.
kyc.connect: Connect the wallet you want attested.
kyc.revokeNote: Revoking shows the other side: any registry that admitted you from it can then have your approval withdrawn, by anyone.
kyc.how1: A KYC provider checks an investor and writes an attestation about their wallet on the Solana Attestation Service: jurisdiction, investor tier, accredited status.
kyc.how2: A registry names the providers it trusts. The investor presents the attestation and the AssetFlow program writes their profile from it: no forms, no issuer back office.
kyc.how3: Every registry that trusts the same provider accepts the same attestation. If the provider revokes it, anyone can withdraw the approval, and then freeze the holder through the gate.

home.title: The same servicing layer, on {chain}.
home.lede: Who may hold a tokenized bond, what each holder is owed on the record date, and how they redeem: the Solana program's rules and arithmetic, as Solidity contracts on {network}, with KYC once through the Ethereum Attestation Service.

register.title: The register keeps itself
register.body: The token keeps every holder's balance over time, so a coupon is owed on the balance at the record date, read straight from the chain. Nobody commits a register, and nothing is paused to take it.

gate.title: Checked on every transfer
gate.body: Units move only between wallets the registry admits today. When an approval lapses, the very next transfer is refused: nobody has to freeze anything first.

kyc.title: KYC once, with EAS
kyc.body: A registry trusts a KYC provider's attestations on the Ethereum Attestation Service. An investor verified once onboards into every registry that trusts the provider; a revocation lets anyone withdraw the approval.

home.contractsLede: Shared by every issuer. Registries and bonds are deployed by issuers from the console; the source is verified on Blockscout.
home.mainnetLede: The same verified contracts, at the same addresses on Base and Arbitrum One: the directory, AssetFlow's investor schema on the chain's EAS, and a pilot note on native USDC (US$1 face, 10%, four semi-annual coupons) with one unit issued. No investor money is involved.
home.ownEas: Robinhood Chain has no Ethereum Attestation Service of its own yet, so AssetFlow deployed the EAS Foundation's contracts there. Registries read KYC from them exactly as they do on Base and Arbitrum.

issuer.title: Issuer console · {chain}
issuer.connectBody: Connect the wallet that will issue and service the bond on {network}. It needs a little {network} ETH for gas.
issuer.registryLede: Deploy your investor registry: the policy and profiles your bonds are gated by. Allow the jurisdictions you serve; each is one confirmation.
issuer.trustDemo: Trust AssetFlow's demo KYC provider, so attested investors can onboard themselves
issuer.steps: {n} confirmations: the registry, its settings, and listing it in the directory.
issuer.bondLede: One deployment: the servicer holds the terms and creates the token. Every coupon, redemption price and maturity payment is computed from these terms.
issuer.name: Name
issuer.currency: Paid in test USD on {network} (get 1,000 from the wallet menu).
issuer.issueLede: Only to a wallet the registry admits today; the token refuses anyone else.
issuer.matured: The bond has matured: no unit can be issued again.

rules.eligible: The token checks the registry at mint and at every transfer, not once when an account was opened.
rules.everyTransfer: A lapsed approval or a compliance hold stops the holder's next transfer outright.
rules.history: Every balance change is recorded with its time, so any record date's register can be read back.

issuer.currencyUsdgNote: Paid in USDG on {network}. Get test USDG from Paxos's faucet, 100 a day, through the wallet menu.

policy.title: KYC provider
policy.lede: Trust a provider's attestations on the Ethereum Attestation Service, and investors it has verified onboard themselves: the registry writes their profile from the attestation. Your policy still applies, and a compliance hold is never lifted by an attestation.
policy.none: No provider trusted: every investor is onboarded by hand.

coupons.termsLine: {face} face per unit · {rate}% a year · 30/360 · paid in {currency}
coupons.registerNote: The register on each record date is every holder's balance at that time, as the token recorded it: nobody commits it, and nothing is paused.
coupons.waiting: Waiting for the record date, {when}. The register is read from the token's history once it has passed.

redemptions.requestsLede: Requested units stay in the holder's wallet, locked, until you answer. Settling pays face plus accrued interest, priced by the contract, and burns the units in the same call; rejecting unlocks them.
redemptions.maturityNote: Coupons stay payable after maturity: each register is already on the chain.
redemptions.short: This wallet holds less than settling a request pays. Get test USD from the wallet menu, then settle.

kyc.title: Demo KYC provider · {chain}
kyc.subtitle: Get verified once, on the Ethereum Attestation Service
kyc.twoSteps: Your wallet signs a message to ask for it, then sends the attestation the provider signed: two prompts.
kyc.how1: A KYC provider checks an investor and signs an attestation about their wallet on the Ethereum Attestation Service: jurisdiction, investor tier, accredited status.

holder.title: Holder portal · {chain}
holder.noBondHint: Open this page from a link your issuer shares, or pick a bond in the {chain} issuer console.
holder.onboardBody: Send this address to the issuer, or get verified by a KYC provider it trusts and onboard yourself.
holder.locked: {units} units are locked on a redemption request.
holder.redeemLede: Ask the issuer to redeem units before maturity. They stay in your wallet, locked, until the issuer settles or declines, and you can withdraw the request until then.

pricing.title: Simple, proposed pricing.
pricing.lede: AssetFlow has no customers yet, so nothing is charged. This is what we propose once a pilot turns into production; the programs stay open source.
